name: GUH
recent: GUH 近期完成苏州土地使用权收回的最后一笔补偿款收取，并多次公告与 Kiyamas Eastern Drill 的经常性关联交易实际金额超出预估。同期董事兼大股东 Datuk Seri Kenneth H'ng Bak Tee 有股份买卖及在闭市期内的交易意向申报。
notable: 苏州政府收回 GUH Suzhou 国有土地使用权，GUH Suzhou 已收到全额补偿约 CNY195.0 million，最后一笔 CNY39.0 million 已支付。
与 Kiyamas Eastern Drill 的经常性关联交易实际金额截至 2026 年 11 月 6 日达 RM1,689,130，较预估 RM1,200,000 偏离 40.76%。
董事兼大股东 Datuk Seri Kenneth H'ng Bak Tee 于 2026 年 10 月 20 日以每股 RM0.241 增持 130,000 股。
risks: 与 Kiyamas Eastern Drill 的经常性关联交易实际金额持续超出预估，累计偏离达 40.76%。
董事兼大股东 Datuk Seri Kenneth H'ng Bak Tee 申报在闭市期内有意买卖公司证券。

news.title: GUH receives last Suzhou land payout
GUH receives final payment for Suzhou land transfer
GUH completes Suzhou land use rights disposal after final CNY39m payment
GUH receives final compensation payment for Suzhou land disposal

recent_en: GUH recently completed the final compensation receipt for the Suzhou land use rights repossession and made several announcements on recurrent related party transactions with Kiyamas Eastern Drill exceeding estimates. Meanwhile, Director and major shareholder Datuk Seri Kenneth H'ng Bak Tee reported share dealings and an intention to deal during the closed period.
notable_en: The Suzhou government repossessed GUH Suzhou's state-owned land use rights, and GUH Suzhou has received full compensation of approximately CNY195.0 million, including the final CNY39.0 million payment.
Actual value of recurrent related party transactions with Kiyamas Eastern Drill reached RM1,689,130 as of 6 November 2026, a deviation of 40.76% from the estimated RM1,200,000.
Director and major shareholder Datuk Seri Kenneth H'ng Bak Tee acquired 130,000 shares at RM0.241 per share on 20 October 2026.
risks_en: Actual value of recurrent related party transactions with Kiyamas Eastern Drill continues to exceed estimates, with cumulative deviation reaching 40.76%.
Director and major shareholder Datuk Seri Kenneth H'ng Bak Tee declared an intention to deal in the company's securities during the closed period.
